 Following years of rumors and reports, Marvel Studios is formulating its next slate of movies that will be released after 2027's Avengers: Secret Wars closes out the Multiverse Saga. Kicking off with X-Men in May 2028, the second movie in the Phase 7 slate will be a new adaptation of Ghost Rider . This will be the third version of the flame-headed antihero to be depicted in live-action, following Nicolas Cage's Johnny Blaze in two big-screen movies and Gabriel Luna's Robbie Reyes in Season 4 of Agents of SHIELD .

 This time, Oscar-nominee Ryan Gosling will take on the Ghost Rider role after publicly campaigning to play the character for years . Marvel announced this casting at San Diego Comic-Con 2026 and revealed that Shawn Levy will direct the movie, marking his second collaboration with Gosling after 2027's Star Wars: Starfighter . As of writing, plot details remain under wraps for the MCU's first take on this famous hero. However, the cast is starting to come together after a new trade report on this highly anticipated reboot.
 According to The Hollywood Reporter , Emmy-nominee Connor Storrie is in talks with Marvel Studios for a role in the upcoming Ghost Rider movie. While the specific role he is discussing has not been revealed, the report notes that it would be the movie's main villain. Storrie became a massive star after his appearance in HBO Max's Heated Rivalry , playing the role of Ilya Rozanov opposite Hudson Williams' Shane Hollander. 
 Photograph by Sabrina Lantos/HBO Max Ryan Gosling as "Sierra Six" in  The Gray Man  Netflix 
 While Storrie became more of a household name after Heated Rivalry , his work in movies and TV dates back to the late 2010s. Other major credits include a small role in 2024's Joker: Folie à Deux and a four-episode arc as Lance Kingston in Season 19 of Criminal Minds . Now, he gets to take on what could be the biggest project of his career, joining one of the most anticipated comic book movies of the next few years for Marvel Studios.
 The real question now is what specific character Storrie will play, as long as his agreement with Marvel Studios is set in stone. Nicolas Cage's movies featured Wes Bentley as Blackheart/Legion, Peter Fonda as Mephisto (before Sacha Baron Cohen took the role in the MCU), future Thor star Idris Elba as Keeper Moreau , and others against Johnny Blaze.

 After this announcement, Marvel continues to push further into development on Ghost Rider , as the same report revealed that filming is expected to begin in New York in 2027. While plot details remain unconfirmed, anticipation is building for this antihero's MCU debut as Marvel Studios moves into its 20th year of making movies.
 Ghost Rider is expected to debut in theaters on Jul. 28, 2028 .
